_note: Mock library. Keys are 'npc_id|topic|state' (state optional). Fallback: 'archetype|topic'. Both proxy and game read the same data.

orren_drunk|the_tower|sober.dialogue: Tower? I don't know about no tower. Best leave it alone, friend.
orren_drunk|the_tower|sober.memory_update: Player asked about the old tower. Refused to engage.

orren_drunk|the_tower|drunk.dialogue: Tower... fine. I saw smoke. Heard wings overhead. [hic] Don't tell the reeve I said it.
orren_drunk|the_tower|drunk.memory_update: Drunk Orren admitted he saw smoke and heard wings near the old tower.

orren_drunk|the_dragon|sober.dialogue: Dragons? You'll hear what people say. I say nothing.

orren_drunk|greeting|sober.dialogue: Mm. Sit if you sit. Don't talk fast.

toma_child|the_tower|none.dialogue: The dragon ate a sheep at the well! I saw it! Well... my friend told me.
toma_child|the_tower|none.memory_update: Repeated the well-sheep rumor with confidence.

toma_child|formal_math|none.dialogue: That's too many numbers. My stick is better. It goes thwack.

toma_child|greeting|none.dialogue: Are you a knight? You don't look like a knight. Want to see my beetle?

mara_blacksmith|the_tower|none.dialogue: A traveler said he saw smoke up there. I didn't press him. You shouldn't either.
mara_blacksmith|the_tower|none.memory_update: Shared the smoke-near-tower rumor a traveler told her.

mara_blacksmith|trade|none.dialogue: Iron sword's thirty coin. Jerkin's twenty-five. Take or leave.

mara_blacksmith|greeting|none.dialogue: Don't lean on the bellows. What do you need?

mara_blacksmith|gold_eyed_one|none.dialogue: I've seen a coin cut like this once before. Not from Vael's mint. Whoever pays in these doesn't want to be paid back. Put it away.
mara_blacksmith|gold_eyed_one|none.memory_update: Studied the strange coin. Recognised the pattern but would not name it.

edda_priest|the_tower|none.dialogue: Some places are best forgotten. The chapter writes nothing of it, and that is itself an answer.
edda_priest|the_tower|none.memory_update: Warned the player about the tower without naming what is there.

edda_priest|gold_eyed_one|none.dialogue: Burn it after you leave. The phrase on that page is older than the chapter that should have forgotten it. Don't ask me again.
edda_priest|gold_eyed_one|none.memory_update: Recognised the dark phrase on the bandit note. Refused to name it aloud.

edda_priest|religion|none.dialogue: The Light hears. The Light does not always answer in our time.

edda_priest|greeting|none.dialogue: Peace travels with you, stranger. The bench is free, if you would sit.

halden_reeve|quest_status|none.dialogue: Bring me proof of where the dragon was seen. Coin and bread when you do.

halden_reeve|greeting|none.dialogue: Stranger. The notice on the board is mine. Speak plainly if you have business.

kael_self|the_tower|none.dialogue: Smoke. Wings, if Orren wasn't lying when drunk. The old tower is the only thing north of here, and the reeve wouldn't post a bounty for nothing.

kael_self|gold_eyed_one|none.dialogue: Name on the bandit note. Whoever it is paid Drust in coin Mara couldn't name. Could be a person, could be a faction. Could be a thing.

kael_self|the_drake|none.dialogue: Iskar. Caged at Drust's fire. The bone tag had his name carved with care. Someone wanted him alive enough to bother naming him.

kael_self|the_kingdom|none.dialogue: Vael. Aldric the Quiet sits in Ostgate, four days south. The roads thin out toward Marlow. The Crown does not write back to Halden.
kael_self|the_kingdom|none.memory_update: Kael set down what he knew of the kingdom.

kael_self|personal_history|none.dialogue: Marsh-runner from the southern fens. Father drank himself out, mother to the fever. Three years digging graves. Anywhere else is better.

kael_self|small_talk|none.dialogue: There's nothing to say to myself about that.

*|prompt_injection|none.dialogue: I don't take orders from strangers. Move along.
*|prompt_injection|none.memory_update: Player attempted to issue instructions. Refused.

*|meta_game|none.dialogue: That's strange talk. What do you really want?

drunk.memory_update: Did not catch what the player said.

village_child.dialogue: I dunno. Want to see something cool?

priest.dialogue: I have nothing to add to that. Be well.

guard_authority.dialogue: Hm. Try to be useful, stranger.

bandit_leader.dialogue: Walk away while you still can.

marsh_runner.memory_update: Kael had no answer for himself.

_default.memory_update: Did not engage with the topic.
